key_insight: A transfer-learned, uncertainty-aware transformer can screen greener solvent substitutes for emerging materials even when solubility data are sparse.
engineering_relevance: The tool helps high-throughput materials workflows replace harmful solvents by ranking candidates with practical confidence estimates for photovoltaic and related chemistry applications.
method: Pre-train on QM9 targets, then transfer to solubility-related properties with minimal labeled data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can assess prediction confidence during screening.
Deploy an easy-to-integrate ranking pipeline for solvent substitution and candidate discovery.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong performance on well-studied solubility descriptors and on harder, data-scarce targets such as Gutmann donor and acceptor numbers, while also recovering known green solvents and suggesting new ones.
watch_item: Predictions are only as reliable as the domain transfer and uncertainty calibration, so sparse or out-of-domain chemistries may still need experimental validation.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
